title: A/R Detail: No locations stays No locations after a new as-of date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location menu lists two.
  • Pick an earlier date, date A, on which both locations had open documents in A/R Detail.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, click "Clear selection".
  2. Close the menu.
  3. Change the as-of date to date A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • No location is ticked.

Step 2:

  • The chip reads "Location: No locations".
  • The table shows "No record matches these filters".

Step 3:

  • The date chip shows date A.
  • The Location chip still reads "Location: No locations" and the table still shows "No record matches these filters".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-E3: “Changing the as-of date keeps every ticked location that is still in the new list (S5-R3). If none of the ticked locations is still in the list, the filter returns to All locations, and the chip reads "Location: All locations". A user who chose No locations keeps No locations.”
  • S5-R6: “The chip reads "Location: All locations" when every location is ticked, the location's name when one is ticked (shortened with "..." when long), "Location: N locations" when N are ticked, and "Location: No locations" when none is.”
  • S5-R6a: “With no location ticked ("Clear selection" or unticking every row), the report shows no rows: the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column. An export from that state downloads nothing and shows "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results", as on Sales By Customer.”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). The design draws no picture of this behaviour (all 7 boards and 45 figures checked); the case follows the PRD.
